text: Public service is about listening, making informed decisions, working together and planning for the future – not politics. As your Helix Water District Board Director since 2006, my record reflects this belief. I’ve consistently worked to ensure that our community’s water supply is safe and reliable while keeping a strong focus on fiscal responsibility, transparency, and excellent customer service, all while working to minimize rate increases whenever possible. I am seeking your vote for re-election to continue delivering practical, experienced and open leadership.

For more than 26 years, I’ve proudly called the Helix Water District community home. I am a third-generation water professional, a Registered Civil Engineer with more than 35 years of experience in the water industry and hold a Master’s Degree in Public Health from SDSU. My experience includes serving as president of the Helix Water District Board and representing Helix on the San Diego County Water Authority Board, where I strongly advocate for reliable water supplies and responsible regional water policies.

As your representative, I have supported responsible budgeting, long-term state-of-the-art infrastructure investments, and efforts to reduce costs whenever possible. I voted to slash a planned water rate increase, helped secure millions of dollars in grants and low-interest financing for critical infrastructure, supported new local water supplies, and promoted investments that strengthen reliability while protecting ratepayer dollars.

I helped strengthen openness and accountability, earning statewide recognition for financial reporting and government transparency. I also support wildfire preparedness, environmental stewardship, and partnerships that benefit our communities.
I’ve stood against unnecessary water supply cuts by the State of California and demanded rate relief for you, my fellow citizens and ratepayers.

Beyond Helix, I serve as president of the Water Conservation Garden Authority, co-president of the Rancho Helix de Oro Fire Safe Council, an elected member of the Valle de Oro Community Planning Group, and a board member of the Grossmont-Mt. Helix Improvement Association. These partnerships and my full engagement help strengthen our neighborhoods and build a safer, more resilient community.

I also believe every customer deserves respectful, responsive service. I support reasonable programs that assist my fellow community members experiencing financial hardship while ensuring the District remains financially strong for future generations.
I remain committed to protecting our water supply, investing responsibly, and ensuring Helix continues to deliver exceptional service today while planning wisely for tomorrow.
I respectfully ask for your vote.

Kathleen Coates Hedberg, PE, MPH

text: I am running for the Helix Water District Board, Division 4, because I believe every resident deserves reliable, affordable access to one of our most essential public resources: water. Effective governance requires thoughtful leadership, responsible financial stewardship, and a long-term commitment to protecting our region’s future. These are the values I will bring to public service.

As someone born and raised in San Diego, I have seen firsthand how drought, flooding, rising costs, and aging infrastructure affect families, businesses, and our communities. Raised by a hardworking blue-collar family, I understand the importance of investing in both the physical infrastructure that delivers clean water and the public institutions that ensure it is managed responsibly. Those experiences inspired me to pursue a career in public service and bring greater community representation to local government.

At sixteen, I began serving the public as a City of San Diego pool lifeguard and have worked in several industries throughout my career. In 2023, I earned my Bachelor’s degree in Political Science from UC San Diego, where I studied and explored internships in public policy and government.

Today, I serve as Director of Policy and Co-Executive Director of a San Diego nonprofit organization. Over the past six years, I have worked with local governments, community organizations, and public leaders to; research important issues, review budgets, support the development of practical policy solutions, and ensure community voices are included in public decision-making. This work has taught me the importance of balancing long-term planning, responsible spending, and the needs of the people we serve.

I believe public trust is earned by listening, making decisions based on facts, operating transparently, and using public resources wisely. These principles will guide my service on the Helix Water District Board.

As our region faces growing environmental and economic challenges, strong public agencies benefit from leaders who bring both responsible governance and fresh perspectives. I will bring experience in public policy, community engagement, and long-term planning to help ensure the Helix Water District remains financially responsible, protects ratepayer resources, and continues providing reliable water service for today’s residents and future generations.
